The central figure is a large adult orangutan seen from the rear, showcasing its shaggy reddish-brown fur and broad back. To the left is a smaller juvenile orangutan sitting and facing away, while to the right another juvenile sits facing forward, looking towards the viewer. The lighting appears natural, casting soft shadows.
